what_happened: Found directly-reusable precedent in lean-mcp-preflight-check.sh (lakefile-based Lean-project detection, explicitly NOT task_type-based, for the same structural reason this task's gate needs) and plan-file-scope-harvest.sh (*.lean file_scope trigger), which grounded both gate signals without needing to invent new detection logic.

agent 'planner-agent' wrote a .return-meta.json but its terminal write never happened (status=in_progress) and produced no orchestrator handoff — RECORD-TIME CORROBORATION: none found (no commit landed inside the dispatch window and dispatch-strand-probe.sh did not report a stranded heartbeat); this occurrence is not evidence of recoverable, work-intact failure.

Research report states the implementation file list 'is already pinned and needs no further discovery' at the 8 file_scope files, but its own recommendation 2 creates context/patterns/mathlib-lookup-gate.md under a context tier the formal manifest's provides.context does not declare (it declares only project/logic, project/math, project/physics). check-extension-docs.sh line 236-240 fails a declared-entry-missing-on-disk, and Rule L reports a deployed context file tracing to no provides.context entry; EXT_DIR defaults to the source store so both apply to the undeployed formal extension. The plan therefore declares 11 files, not 8, adding manifest.json and index-entries.json, and orders Phase 1 file-first/manifest-second so no intermediate state is red.

Sourcing scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh and calling suite_selection_select directly at plan-authoring time grounded every Tier Justification mechanically instead of by guess: the agent/skill markdown paths return __FULL_SWEEP__ (so plan-format.md sub-case (b) applies, gate 3,4 with the repo root as TARGET), while manifest.json and index-entries.json resolve to a 27-of-143-suite union that makes 'interface' an honestly cheapest covering tier for Phase 1 rather than a reflexive 'full'. Cost: two bash calls.
